items.title: Write the cross-cutting workflow convergence execution plan
items.context: Turn the confirmed six-claim diagnosis into an implementation-ready Markdown decision document. Include evidence, adopted corrections, five cohesive workstreams, acceptance criteria, rollout dependencies, risk controls, and explicit non-goals.

happy.desc: Inspect the delivered Markdown decision document and map the six confirmed diagnoses to exactly five cohesive implementation workstreams: DONE timeout/receipt reuse; unattended host liveness plus candidate-routing specificity; typed dispatch; owner-session identity; canonical scope paths plus semantic anchors. Each workstream states evidence-backed root cause, adopted/modified/rejected remedy, implementation boundary, dependencies, rollout/rollback, and positive acceptance criteria. WHY: the umbrella plan must be directly decomposable into independent stories without combining unrelated runtime changes.

Cross-check the document citations and source-of-truth statements against all checklist relatedDocs: done-prepare automation and heartbeat/review assurance, multi-host candidate routing, owner-session contract and write leases, scope-guard guide, and role separation. The document distinguishes existing canonical policy from proposed changes and does not supersede those sources accidentally. WHY: implementation stories must consume authoritative contracts instead of stale diagnostic prose.

Review the document end to end and confirm one internally consistent landing order, dependency graph, priority rationale, ownership boundary, shared terminology, and explicit non-goals; confirm it remains documentation-only and makes no claim that runtime behavior is already fixed. WHY: the plan must be auditable and safe to execute incrementally.

edge.desc: For DONE-required validation with multiple sequential commands, verify the plan rejects an outer timeout derived only from max(command timeout) and specifies either no redundant outer deadline or sum(effective command deadlines)+bounded grace, while fresh-receipt reuse remains bound to current HEAD/material/story-files/policy/command set. WHY: a superficially larger timeout must not preserve deterministic failure or weaken evidence freshness.

For unattended routing, verify the plan treats launcherSupport=unverified as ineligible for unattended execution, separates probe timeout from real host-process liveness, preserves explicit relatedDocs/typed risk signals when filtering generic tokens, and keeps shadow mode advisory rather than enforce-blocking. WHY: fixing stalls and over-scan must not hide authoritative documents or silently change configured mode semantics.

For owner identity and scope normalization, verify the plan requires stable per-task and per-agent/role identity rather than a repo-wide token, and requires an explicit canonical path base plus traversal/symlink containment and legacy migration. WHY: the fixes must not collapse reviewer/implementer identities or broaden write scope.

adversarial.desc: Challenge the dispatch workstream with verification-intent, test-intent, unknown, story-level reviewer, and item-level reviewer inputs. Acceptance must require an explicit fail-closed agent-type registry, schema-valid prompts, current verification-intent naming, and no fallback of unknown/reviewer roles to implementer instructions. WHY: prefix patches alone can continue role pollution and unauthorized status/commit guidance.

Challenge the scope-anchor workstream with if/for/while/switch blocks, local const declarations, methods, nested functions, protected anchors, repo-relative versus package-relative paths, .. traversal, and symlink escape. Acceptance must prefer AST-based declaration anchors (regex exclusion only as stopgap), preserve protected-anchor fail-closed behavior, and version parsing/hash semantics so old evidence becomes explicitly stale rather than silently reinterpreted. WHY: eliminating false positives must not introduce false negatives or evidence ambiguity.

Review every workstream for regression controls and negative acceptance cases: true child-process hangs still terminate and clean up; stale or mismatched DONE receipts are rejected; high-specificity routing still finds explicit documents; reviewer evidence cannot be self-attested; independent sessions still conflict correctly; genuine out-of-scope/protected-anchor writes still block. WHY: each convenience fix must preserve existing safety gates.

Attempt to interpret the umbrella plan as authorization to implement all five workstreams in one story, change runtime behavior in this documentation story, use host=fake as a production remedy, hard-code an unexplained 40% corpus threshold, or use CODEX_THREAD_ID/repo token as sole owner identity. The document must explicitly reject these readings in non-goals and story slicing. WHY: known tempting shortcuts would recreate cost imbalance or weaken role/evidence separation.

auditLog.reason: Drafted the execution plan and am completing verification and commit.
